Name: ATK_OPERATION_PARTS_PARAM_ST
Description: Determines the operation state of various joints. For players.

Fields.Name: Operation: Lower Body
Fields.Description: If ON, the lower body is set as operating for this row.

Fields.Name: Operation: Right Arm
Fields.Description: If ON, the right arm is set as operating for this row.

Fields.Name: Operation: Left Arm
Fields.Description: If ON, the left arm is set as operating for this row.

Fields.Name: Operation: Right Back
Fields.Description: If ON, the right back unit is set as operating for this row.

Fields.Name: Operation: Left Back
Fields.Description: If ON, the left back unit is set as operating for this row.

Fields.Name: Operation: Right Arm - Stance
Fields.Description: If ON, the right arm stance (aiming) is set as operating for this row.

Fields.Name: Operation: Left Arm - Stance
Fields.Description: If ON, the left arm stance (aiming) is set as operating for this row.

Fields.Name: Operation: Upper Body
Fields.Description: If ON, the upper body is set as operating for this row.

Fields.Name: Operation: Guard
Fields.Description: If ON, guarding is set as operating for this row.

Fields.Name: Operation: Assault Boost
Fields.Description: If ON, Assault Boost is set as operating for this row.

Fields.Name: Operation: Right Back - Stance
Fields.Description: If ON, the right back unit stance (aiming) is set as operating for this row.

Fields.Name: Operation: Left Back - Stance
Fields.Description: If ON, the left back unit stance (aiming) is set as operating for this row.

Fields.Name: Operation: Right Hand - Reload
Fields.Description: If ON, right hand reloading is set as operating for this row.

Fields.Name: Operation: Left Hand - Reload
Fields.Description: If ON, left hand reloading is set as operating for this row.

Fields.Name: Operation: Right Back - Simultaneous Fire
Fields.Description: Right back unit simultaneous fire, used for movement cancellation.

Fields.Name: Operation: Left Back - Simultaneous Fire
Fields.Description: Left back unit simultaneous fire, used for movement cancellation.
